pharma.title: Wockhardt’s Novel Antibiotic Zaynich Wins CDSCO Marketing Nod
pharma.summary: Wockhardt has secured marketing approval from the Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) for its novel antibiotic Zaynich. The drug targets severe, multi-drug-resistant bacterial infections.
pharma.source_title: Wockhardt’s Novel Antibiotic Zaynich Wins CDSCO Marketing Nod - IndiaMedToday

pharma.title: CDSCO Prohibits Injectable Use of Cosmetics
pharma.summary: The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) issued a regulatory directive prohibiting the administration of cosmetic products via injections. The authority reiterated that cosmetics are legally defined as distinct from medicines and cannot be approved for parenteral delivery.
pharma.source_title: Cosmetics Are Not Medicines: CDSCO Prohibits Injectable Use - SCC Online

pharma.title: Novo Nordisk's Wegovy approved for teens in India
pharma.summary: Novo Nordisk's anti-obesity medication Wegovy received regulatory clearance from Indian drug authorities for use in adolescents. The approval broadens medical interventions available for pediatric weight management in the country.

national.title: Maharashtra govt to create AI Innovation Regions across the state

national.title: Kerala plans three-day menstrual leave for schoolgirls
